description: This file defines the Metric class used within the SuiteCRM project, including its constructor and accessor methods.

classes.name: Metric
classes.description: Represents a metric with a type, name, and mutability property.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Metric object with specified type and name, setting mutability based on name.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the metric.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the metric.

methods.name: isMutable
methods.description: Indicates whether the metric is mutable.
